title: Side Ended Up Busting
text: Side Ended Up Busting. At first, I really loved this pillow and thought it was great but then I noticed the side of it looked a little weird, and then the next day I noticed the whole side of the pillow had blown out and the stuffing was coming out. So the make of the pillow is pretty bad for it to just blow out like it did when I was just sleeping on it and didn't have much weight on it at all. The stitching just popped out and came out making the stuffing pour out. Ended up having to throw out the whole pillow because it was just so bad. Really a shame because it was a pretty nice pillow.
